evidence.quote: So, today I would like to discuss how we can create a regulatory environment that fosters successful innovation.

Financial innovation must be a core regulatory priority, in the sense that we must devote regulatory and supervisory resources and attention to building a framework that permits responsible innovation to flourish.
A reflexive "no" from regulators can encourage activity to migrate out of the banking system.
